claim.claim-text: 1. A solar cell (150) comprising:

2. The solar cell (150) according to claim 1, wherein the 6 or more bus bar lines (42b) have a first distance between two neighboring ones of the bus bar lines (42b), and a second distance between one of the bus bar lines (42b) adjacent to an edge of the solar cell and the edge of the solar cell, the second distance being greater than the first distance; and an edge distance (D) is defined between one end of the one of the bus bar lines (42b) and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto or between the other end of the one of the bus bar lines (42b) and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto, the edge distance being smaller than the first distance and the second distance..
3. The solar cell (150) according to any one of the preceding claims,

wherein each of the bus bar lines (42b) comprises a plurality of pad sections (422) arranged to be spaced apart from one another in the second direction; and each of the pad sections (422) has a length (L2) in the second direction greater than a width (W5) of the plurality of finger lines (42a).

4. The solar cell (150) according to claim 3, wherein each of the bus bar lines (42b) further comprise a line section (421) connecting the plurality of pad sections (422) in the second direction while having a smaller width than the plurality of pad sections.

5. The solar cell (150) according to claim 3 or 4, wherein the plurality of pad sections (422) comprise first pad sections (422a) and the second pad sections (422b) having different widths in the first direction or different lengths in the second direction.
6. The solar cell (150) according to claim 5,

wherein the width in the first direction or the length in the second direction of the first pad sections (422a) is greater than the width in the first direction or the length in the second direction of the second pad sections (422b); and the first pad sections (422a) are disposed at opposite ends of the line section (421) in the second direction, respectively.
7. The solar cell (150) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein at least one of the following is fulfilled:

wherein an edge distance (D) of 2.37 to 21.94mm is defined between one end of the one of the bus bar lines (42b) and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto or between the other end of the one of the bus bar lines (42b) and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto; and wherein an edge area (PA) is defined between one end of the one of the bus bar lines (42b) and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto or between the other end of the one of the bus bar lines (42b) and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto, and the edge area (PA) having a width of 0.73 to 3mm at a position adjacent to a corresponding one of the edges of the solar cell.
8. The solar cell (150) according to claim 7, wherein the edge distance (D) is 9 to 15.99mm.

9. The solar cell (150) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein an edge area (PA) is defined between one end of the one of the bus bar electrode lines and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto or between the other end of the one of the bus bar electrode lines and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto; and

- when "L" represents a width of the edge area at a position adjacent to a corresponding one of the edges of the solar cell, and "D" represents an edge distance being a length of the edge area, "L" and "D" satisfy the following Expression: 0.9 * 0.1569 * D + 0.3582 ≤ L ≤ 1.1 * 0.1569 * D + 0.3582
where, the unit of "L" is mm, and the unit of "D" is mm.

10. The solar cell (150) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein each of the bus bar lines (42b) has a distance between opposite ends thereof in the second direction smaller than a distance between outermost ones of the finger lines (42a) respectively disposed at opposite sides of the semiconductor substrate (160) in the second direction.
11. A solar cell panel (100) comprising:

a plurality of solar cells (150) each comprising a photoelectric converter, and a first electrode (42) and a second electrode (44) connected to the photoelectric converter; and a plurality of leads (142) for connecting neighboring ones of the plurality of solar cells such that the first electrode (42) in one of the neighboring solar cells is connected to the second electrode (44) in the other of the neighboring solar cells, wherein: each of the first electrode (42) and the second electrode (44) comprises a plurality of finger lines (42a) formed to extend in a first direction while being parallel, and 6 or more bus bar lines (42b) formed to extend in a second direction crossing the first direction, and the plurality of leads (142) have a diameter or width of 250 to 500µm, and comprise 6 or more leads arranged at one surface side of the solar cell while being connected to the bus bar lines (42b), respectively.

12. The solar cell panel (100) according to claim 11, wherein an edge distance of 2.37 to 21.94mm is defined between one end of the one of the bus bar lines (42b) and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto or between the other end of the one of the bus bar lines (42b) and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto.
13. The solar cell panel (100) according to claim 12, wherein:

14. The solar cell according to any one of claims 11 to 13, wherein, when "W" represents the width of the leads, and "D" represents an edge distance between one end of the one of the bus bar electrode lines and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto or between the other end of the one of the bus bar electrode lines and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto, "W" and "D" satisfy the following Expression: 13.732 * ln W − 71.436 − 0.0000321462 * W 2 ≤ D ≤ 13.732 * ln W − 71.436 + 0.0000321462 * W 2
where, the unit of "W" is µm, and the unit of "D" is mm.

15. The solar cell module according to of claims 11 to 14, wherein each of the plurality of leads has one end disposed on one of the neighboring solar cells between one end of a corresponding one of the bus bar electrode lines and an edge of the solar cell adjacent thereto, and the other end connected to a corresponding one of the bus bar electrode lines on the other of the neighboring solar cells.
